The '''Taanab exercise''' was a problem that students in [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi academy]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] were asked to solve as part of their training.

The problem simulated was about a flood that was about to strike a [[Taanab/Legends|Taanabi]] village. The students were asked to bring up the best solution to the problem. [[Anakin Solo]] found a way to create a levee by using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to loosen some rocks. While Anakin got high marks for the solution, he had not paid enough attention to the history of the village, a fact which was later criticized by [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] during their stay on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Apparently, the residents of the village knowingly settled in the floodplain, thus were in a constant danger of being flooded. Anakin's solution, while being effective on the spot, didn't provide the settlers with a way to independently solve the problem, leaving them to trust the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] next time disaster struck.
